summary: The MCP code-orchestration GET path pages n8n lists through bound.EndpointPageResponse with cursor/nextCursor and decodes the opaque MCP cursor on the next call.
reason: codeOrchInvoke used EndpointResponse without page options, so a list larger than the MCP budget kept n8n's nextCursor after dropping rows; following it skipped the dropped rows. The per-endpoint handlers that do page correctly are not registered for this CLI. Generator template gap.
validated_outcome: TestCodeOrchPagingKeepsTruncatedRows and TestCodeOrchPagingKeepsRequestCursor: an over-budget page returns a local continuation cursor anchored to the requested server page, never the server nextCursor.
